
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

candidate_paths <- c(
  "examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv",
  "../../examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv"
)

nhanes_path <- candidate_paths[file.exists(candidate_paths)][1]
if (is.na(nhanes_path)) {
  stop("Could not find examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv")
}

nhanes_analysis <- read_csv(nhanes_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

nhanes_analysis |>
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    missing_bmi = sum(is.na(BMI)),
    missing_income = sum(is.na(IncomeGroup))
  )
  ```

  ```{r}
  nhanes_analysis |>
  filter(!is.na(BMI), !is.na(IncomeGroup), Age >= 20, Age <= 80) |>
  group_by(IncomeGroup) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_bmi = round(mean(BMI), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Cohort

```{r}
analysis_df <- nhanes |>
  filter(Age >= 20, Age <= 80)

cohort_counts <- tibble(
  step = c("Prepared CSV rows", "After age 20-80 restriction"),
  n = c(nrow(nhanes), nrow(analysis_df))
)

cohort_counts
```

## Missingness

```{r}
key_vars <- c("BMI", "Age", "IncomeGroup", "Gender", "Race", "Cycle")

missingness <- tibble(variable = key_vars) |>
  mutate(
    missing_n = vapply(analysis_df[key_vars], function(x) sum(is.na(x)), numeric(1)),
    missing_percent = round(100 * missing_n / nrow(analysis_df), 1)
  )

missingness
```

```{r}
missingness <- analysis_df |>
    select(BMI, Age, IncomeGroup, Gender, Race, Cycle) |>
    summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x)))) |>
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Missing") |>
    mutate(Percent_Missing = 100 * Missing / nrow(analysis_df))
missingness
```

## Table 1
```{r}
mean_sd <- function(x) {
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}

table1 <- analysis_df |>
  filter(!is.na(IncomeGroup)) |>
  group_by(IncomeGroup) |>
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    `BMI, mean (SD)` = mean_sd(BMI),
    `Age, mean (SD)` = mean_sd(Age),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(table1)
```
